02 / A little more thought in every bite

A gentler process.
Still all crunch.

Vacuum frying uses lower temperatures than conventional frying. It's an approach studied for reducing oil uptake, while giving familiar ingredients a different kind of bite.

Lower frying temperatures

Oil uptake, considered
